purpose: Selected-case feasibility of teacher-refold feedback through the explicitly trained isolated-fragment conditioner, versus equal-budget fresh sampling.
selection: Among coarse-valid refolds of the previous feedback backbone, choose minimum proper motif CA RMSD, then minimum motif dRMS, then higher global self-consistency TM, then lower sequence index. No complete experimental reference is used. With no valid refold, use the previous generated backbone and record fallback.
conditioning: Whole selected refold is canonicalized and encoded; partial flow starts at 0.8*z_refold+0.2*fresh_noise. Keep original isolated-fragment features. Never rotate latent channels or clamp standalone fragment codes into whole-chain codes.
budget: Reuse initial eight refolds per selected case. Two further backbones per case per arm, each with eight fixed-motif designs/refolds. Two fixed-motif native controls per round. 96 new refolds:64 generated and32 controls. Per arm per case:24 designs including the shared initial eight. Both arms use the same fresh Gaussian and decoder noise and50 velocity evaluations per additional backbone.
endpoints: Report each round and cumulative strict same-refold success; global scTM>0.5, raw and same refold coarse-valid, raw and same refold proper motif RMSD<=1A and motif dRMS<=1A. Retain every failed sample. Record timing and memory. No tolerance, strength or noise sweep.
scope: Two post-selected development cases with raw motif retention but refold drift; repair feasibility only, no generalization claim. No development refold becomes a training label. No locked tests. Continue to a fixed-panel comparison only if feedback yields strict success with passing native controls.
